name: Cities Of Refuge
overview: The cities of refuge, as outlined in Numbers 35, were established to provide protection for those who committed manslaughter unintentionally, distinguishing them from willful murderers who were to be put to death. These cities offered a lawful asylum where manslayers could flee and be safeguarded from the avenger of blood until they stood trial and remained until the high priest’s death, highlighting God's provision of justice tempered with mercy. This system underscores the holiness of life and the necessity of righteous judgment, while also pointing forward to Christ as the ultimate refuge and hope for sinners.
